g.text: The goblins across the river grow bold. The guards on the bridge
keep them honest, mostly. If you go over, go armed, and don't go
Ho there, Corwen. Welcome to Morningside Castle. Mind your manners in the Duke's hall.
Soup for twenty, and nine to eat it. The pigs have never had it so good.
The goblins across the river grow bold. The guards on the bridge keep them honest, mostly. If you go over,
go armed, and don't go alone.
